mm264_invalid_handling: Current invalid value replaced with median of valid MM264 current anchors on training windows only; current-invalid indicator 1. If t or t-300s invalid, delta set 0, delta-invalid indicator 1. No model-window deletion and no use of future measurements. This 10% value was chosen after viewing Apr28 development event, so this is a new exploratory pipeline, not a blind prespecification.
model: StandardScaler and LogisticRegression(C=1.0,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=1000,random_state=20260926) on training part only; baseline must reproduce original A coefficients/threshold exactly
threshold: For both variants use G1/A rule on training scores only: 501 empirical quantile grid plus always silent; maximize matched proxy events subject to <=2 false new alerts per 24 eligible background hours; ties by fewer false episodes, fewer duplicate positive starts, then higher threshold
selection_windows: Build from May1-May23 only; require full local 600s history, 180s quiet and 360+29s future entirely within this period, preserving original B2 MM256 event and eligibility code. No April-to-May context and no May24 context; both variants use identical windows and proxy events.
limited_support_criterion: Only if >=10 evaluable selection proxy events AND robust model has a net gain of at least 2 >=60s matched events vs baseline AND at least 2 event onsets uniquely matched by robust model on at least 2 different dates AND false new alerts per 24 eligible background hours <=2 AND <=baseline; otherwise do not claim selection-period incremental evidence. Even passing supports only this Polish-mine MM256 proxy task.
candidate_freeze_gate: First run development-only preparation, independently commit exact candidate JSON SHA and a selection lock. Human reviews and confirms the locked protocol before any selection-period labels or scores are read. No refit, retune or repeated scoring on selection.
reserved_policy: Do not access or score 2014-05-24 to 2014-06-16 in J1; further use requires separate project decision.
